questiontext.text:
Question ID: CW_U06_L01_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.WR.08

Portfolio context: A writer says, "I chose this poem because I like it." What is the best revision of the selection reason?

answer.text: A. I chose this poem because it was short.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Length alone is not craft evidence. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

answer.text: B. I chose this poem because I found it first.

feedback.text: Incorrect. File order does not prove portfolio value.

answer.text: C. I chose no pieces because portfolios do not need writing.

feedback.text: Incorrect. A portfolio requires selected work. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

answer.text: D. I chose this poem because the revised final image shows stronger control of imagery and emotion.

feedback.text: Correct. This gives a craft-based reason supported by revision evidence.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: CW_U06_L01_GP_Q02

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.WR.08

Which item is the strongest evidence for a craft rationale?

answer.text: A. A statement that the piece exists.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Existence is not evidence of craft growth.

answer.text: B. A random font change.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Random formatting does not show craft rationale.

answer.text: C. A before-and-after revision that changes "I was lonely" into a specific bus stop image.

feedback.text: Correct. This shows a concrete revision and craft improvement.

answer.text: D. A sentence saying the piece is good.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This is vague praise, not evidence. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: CW_U06_L01_GP_Q03

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.WR.08

Which three parts belong in a complete craft rationale?

answer.text: A. Selection claim, evidence, and reader effect.

feedback.text: Correct. These parts explain why the piece belongs in the portfolio.

answer.text: B. Title, font, and file name.

feedback.text: Incorrect. These do not explain craft growth. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

answer.text: C. Summary, summary, and more summary.

feedback.text: Incorrect. A rationale needs evidence and effect, not only summary.

answer.text: D. Favorite line, favorite color, and page number.

feedback.text: Incorrect. These do not form a complete rationale.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: CW_U06_L01_GP_Q04

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.WR.08

A writer revised direct emotion into an image. What should the rationale explain?

answer.text: A. That revision does not matter.

feedback.text: Incorrect. The revision is central evidence. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

answer.text: B. How the image helps the reader infer the emotion instead of being told directly.

feedback.text: Correct. This connects craft evidence to reader effect.

answer.text: C. That the image was chosen randomly.

feedback.text: Incorrect. A rationale should show purpose. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

answer.text: D. That readers should ignore the image.

feedback.text: Incorrect. The image is important evidence. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: CW_U06_L01_GP_Q05

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.WR.08

Which rationale is weakest?

answer.text: A. I selected this story because the revised dialogue reveals conflict more clearly.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This is a craft-based rationale. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

answer.text: B. I selected this poem because the line breaks now slow the reader at the final image.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This explains craft effect. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

answer.text: C. I selected this script because feedback helped me add speaker labels that clarify performance.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This uses revision evidence. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

answer.text: D. I selected this piece because it is nice and I like it.

feedback.text: Correct. This is weakest because it gives vague praise without evidence.
